pidamos: pedir — let us ask (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; = pidamos)
digamos: dezir — let us say (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; digamos que 'let us say that'; = digamos)
llevaremos: llevar (levar) — we shall carry, take (future 1st pl., spelt with ll; = llevaremos)
enseñar: enseñar — to show, point out (infinitive; also first half of a split future, enseñar las hemos 'we shall show them'; = enseñar, mostrar)
heredadas: heredar — endowed with an inheritance, provided with lands (past part. fem. pl.; ser heredadas 'to be endowed, have one's estates'; = heredadas, dotadas de heredades)
retrayan: retraer — they may reproach, cast up against (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; nos retrayan 'they may throw in our faces', Pidal 'nos echen en cara'; = retraigan)
levaremos: levar — we shall carry, take along (future 1st pl.; = llevaremos)
valen: valer — they are worth (present 3rd pl.; averes que valen grant valor 'goods of great worth'; = valen)
escarniremos: escarnir (escarnecer) — we shall mock, dishonour, humiliate (future 1st pl.; = escarneceremos, closest deshonraremos)
callar: callar — to fall silent, be silent (infinitive; fizo callar la cort 'he made the court fall silent'; = callar)
arras: arras — dower: the towns and lands the bridegroom gives the bride on marrying her (fem. pl.; Pidal 'las villas y tierras que el varón da a la mujer al casarse con ella'; meter en arras 'to put in possession of the dower', Pidal 'posesionar de las arras'; = arras); distinct from axuvar, the trousseau from the bride's parents
diemos: dar — we gave (preterite 1st pl., old -ie- form; = dimos)
veran: ver — they will see (future 3rd pl., unaccented as printed; = verán)
oviéremos: aver — we may have, shall have (future subjunctive 1st pl.; los fijos que oviéremos 'the sons we may have'; = hubiéremos, now expressed by tengamos)
avrán: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl.; = habrán)
partiçión: partiçión — division, share in an inheritance (fem.; aver partiçión 'to have a share'; = partición)
curiava: curiar — to guard, take care of; reflexive curiarse de 'to be on one's guard against, suspect' (imperfect 3rd sg.; nos curiava de = non se curiava de 'he had no suspicion of', Pidal 'no se recelaba'; = (se) cuidaba, recelaba)
diestes: dar — you gave (preterite 2nd pl., old -istes; = disteis)
quiéroles: querer + les — I wish (present 1st sg., with diphthong, + enclitic dative les 'to them'; = les quiero)
paños: paño — cloth, fabric, garment of cloth (masc. pl.; = paños)
çiclatones: çiclatón — ciclatón, a rich silk cloth, gold-worked or fine (masc. pl.; = ciclatones)
levades: levar — you carry off, take away (present 2nd pl., old -ades; = lleváis)
telas: tela — web, membrane; telas del coraçón 'the membranes of the heart', what is dearest (fem. pl.; = telas)
enbio: enbiar — I send (present 1st sg., unaccented as printed; = envío)
servides: servir — you serve (present indicative 2nd pl., old -ides; si bien las servides 'if you serve them well'; = servís)
rendré: render — I shall give, pay back (future 1st sg., syncopated; vos rendré galardón 'I shall repay you'; = rendiré)
atorgado: atorgar — granted, agreed to (past part. masc. sg., with lo; atorgado lo han 'they have agreed to it'; = otorgado)
mandavan: mandar — they were ordering (imperfect 3rd pl.; = mandaban)
escurren: escurrir — they see off, escort a departing traveller on his way (present 3rd pl.; Pidal 'despiden', comp. v. 1067; = despiden, acompañan)
cid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (spelt without the cedilla where Pidal restores the word in italics, [Cid]; = Çid)
espidimiento: espidimiento — leave-taking, farewell (masc.; en espidimiento son 'they are taking their leave'; = despedida)
pedimos: pedir — we ask (present 1st pl.; merçed vos pedimos 'we ask your favour'; = pedimos)
engendrastes: engendrar — you begot (preterite 2nd pl., old -astes; = engendrasteis)
parió: parir — she bore, gave birth to (preterite 3rd sg.; = parió)
enviades: enviar — you send (present 2nd pl., old -ades; = enviáis)
cunplir: cunplir — to fulfil, carry out (infinitive; debdo nos es a cunplir 'it is our duty to carry out'; = cumplir)
mandáredes: mandar — you shall command (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; lo que mandáredes 'whatever you command'; = mandareis, now expressed by mandéis)
abraçólas: abraçar + las — he embraced them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic object las; = las abrazó)
saludólas: saludar + las — he greeted them, with the kiss of greeting or farewell (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic object las; Pidal 'las besó'; = las saludó, las besó)
doblava: doblar — he/she doubled, did as much again (imperfect 3rd sg.; la madre lo doblava 'the mother did it twice over'; = doblaba)
andad: andar — go, go on (imperative 2nd pl.; = andad, closest id)
bendixieron: bendezir — they blessed (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = bendijeron)
diéronles: dar + les — they gave them (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic dative les; = les dieron)
penssavan: penssar (pensar) — they were thinking (imperfect 3rd pl.; penssar de + inf. 'to set about, make ready to'; = pensaban)
clara: claro — bright, fair, illustrious (fem. sg.; Valençia la clara 'Valencia the fair'; = clara)
avueros: agüero — omen, augury (masc. pl.; en los avueros 'in the omens', by observing omens; = agüeros)
tacha: tacha — flaw, blemish, stain on one's honour (fem.; non … sin alguna tacha 'not without some blemish'; = tacha)
repentir: repentir — to repent, go back on (infinitive, used reflexively: nos puede repentir = non se puede repentir 'he cannot go back on it'; = arrepentirse)

__broaden__.darvos: dar + vos — to give you (infinitive + enclitic vos) · also darvos — dar + vos, first half of a split future 'I shall give you' (darvos he mis fijas 'I shall give you my daughters'; darvos [he] mulas; = os daré)
__broaden__.mandó: mandar — he ordered (preterite 3rd sg.; = mandó) · also mandar — 'he held, governed' a place (Çorita mandó 'he held Çorita'; el que mandó a Mont Mayor 'he who governed Mont Mayor') · also mandar — he offered as a gift, bestowed (lo que el Çid mandó 'what the Çid bestowed'; Pidal 'ofreció en don')
__broaden__.nuevas: nueva — news, tidings (fem. pl.; sus nuevas legavan 'his news was arriving'; = noticias, nuevas) · also nuevas — renown, fame (las nuevas de mio Çid sonando van; Pidal 'renombre, fama') · also nuevas — affairs, doings (las nuevas del cavallero 'the knight's affairs'; Pidal 'los asuntos, los negocios') · also nuevas — exploits, deeds (las nuevas que faze el Campeador; Pidal 'las hazañas que hace') · also grandes son las nuevas 'there is a great stir' (Pidal 'gran actividad o animación hay')
__broaden__.teniendo: tener — holding (gerund; teniendo a la çaga 'holding the rearguard'; = teniendo) · also tener armas 'to play at arms', mock combat in display (teniendo salien armas, Pidal 'salían jugando las armas'; comp. v. 1577)
__broaden__.sues: su — his, her (fem. pl. possessive, old sue/sues; = sus) · also 'their' (todas sues compañas 'all their (or his) companies')
